gist: Scotland bounced back from their New Zealand defeat by beating Australia at Murrayfield.
Gregor Townsend praised his side's defensive effort in difficult weather conditions.
Rory Darge captained Scotland and won the player-of-the-match award.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Scotland edged past Australia in a physical match at Murrayfield after overcoming wet and chilly conditions. Max Jorgensen scored a late converted try for the Wallabies, but Darcy Graham made a crucial tackle on Tom Wright to secure the win.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The victory helped Scotland build momentum following their heavy defeat against New Zealand the previous weekend, allowing them to bounce back and show defensive resilience.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Scotland prepare to face Japan next Saturday.

fivew: Scotland defeated Australia in a tight rugby match.
A chilly and damp day following the previous weekend's matches.
To recover momentum after Scotland's disappointing loss to New Zealand.
